rules: Previous-day paid debt outranks all discretionary work when debt exists.
Current-day paid quota outranks free funnel publishing and Microsoft Store discretionary work.
Free manuscript production or publication never replaces paid debt/floor.
Evaluate note demand using free+paid pairs and compare funnel performance only at equal 24h/72h/7d post-publication age.
A strong free signal alone is a demand signal, not proof of revenue-winning status.
Strong free response with weak paid conversion requires CTA/value-gap/price/theme-match optimization before derivative production.
Weak free and paid response means do not amplify that theme.
Do not invent PV, likes, follows, clicks, purchases, revenue, acquisitions, installs, retention or CVR.
Do not mass-clone low-signal themes or cosmetic Store variants.
